---
title: Neapolitan Crostini
id: MAR-0029
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 8 slices of country bread
- 9 anchovy fillets
- 2 mozzarella
- 2 tomatoes
- 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste oregano
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Cut the mozzarella into small cubes and the anchovies into small pieces.
2. Wash the tomatoes, cut them in half, remove the seeds and excess water, and cut them into small cubes.
3. Cut the bread slices in half, brush them with oil and arrange the anchovy pieces, mozzarella cubes and tomato cubes on top; season with oil and a little salt, then sprinkle with oregano.
4. Arrange the crostini on the baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and bake at 200 °C for about 5 minutes.
